title: New Releases: CyberCity Central Security, KR Desert Kingdom Tileset

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
Two new tilesets out now for RPG Maker!
​
Alert, alert! New tiles to increase the military presence in your game are here thanks to the CyberCity Central Security pack! PVGames is back with another pack in their CyberCity series, this time focusing on cold concrete and metal to create a harsh technology-filled world for your heroes to fight for or against. More than 1,800 tiles are ready to help you build long hallways where your heroes need to avoid cameras and barricades, jail cells where your heroes may make unlikely connections, barracks for the city’s soldiers, and more!
Perfect for parallax mapping, each object in this pack comes in 8 different directions so you can set up your maps exactly how you imagine them. Create war rooms with monitors lining every wall so your villains can keep a close eye on the entire city, or fill your hero’s base with hastily gathered crates and sandbags so they can survive without getting caught by security. Add sentry guns to the tops of buildings to tell your players that they shouldn’t just wander into those places without a plan, and make prisons with sturdy watchtowers and concrete walls that your heroes will need to escape if they are unlucky enough to be caught while searching for info!
Need some buildings to fill out your city or some warehouse interior maps for a short cutscene? Then make sure to use this pack’s 17 pre-built buildings and warehouse space that you can fill with enemy weapons or equipment for your heroes to use! If your game needs some dangerous military bases to sneak into or you want to show just how deadly the corrupt city’s soldiers are, check out the CyberCity Central Security pack!

​
Build stone cities for your heroes to rest in while exploring sandy dungeons with the KR Desert Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another set of tiles to create a full town found in the hot and dry deserts of your game’s world. A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 5 B sheets offer up a bunch of stone and clay to create your town’s solid base, and then decorate it with tile entryways and draped canopies to help keep the sun off the townsfolk when they’re out shopping and gossiping. Let your heroes recover from battles by resting on comfy large cushions, and have them go shopping to find new curved swords, cooling fruits, and cloth armor that protects them from heat.
Need to make an abandoned building for your heroes to explore, or destroy a town after the final boss releases a deadly plague? Then grab the crack autotiles and the destroyed versions of some of the B tiles to turn a cozy home into a ruined shell! Torn papers, busted vases, and ripped fabric make interiors unlivable while crumbling arches and pillars and cracked domes make building exteriors feel dangerous to enter. This pack also includes carved arched doors to help keep the hot air out of bedrooms as well as a floating magic carpet that your heroes could use to quickly traverse the empty desert dunes! Pick up the KR Desert Kingdom Tileset and create sandy marketplaces, oasis inns, and ransacked castles in your desert areas!
